name: KwaiKAT
description: KwaiKAT is Kuaishou's coding-model team behind the KAT-Coder family. Kuaishou lists its corporate contact address in Beijing, China. Its public model IDs use the kwaipilot namespace.

sources.notes: Kuaishou's official contact page lists its address in Haidian District, Beijing, China; this is recorded as the parent-company location, not a separate KwaiKAT office.

verification.notes: Location metadata verified for the parent company; the source does not establish a separate KwaiKAT headquarters.
